note: fixed by c8342ea (test: tools/test/guards.test.mjs 'bashWrites: ... cd ...' — paths('cd "$WT" && echo x > README.md') must be ['?README.md']). A cd whose target the guard cannot resolve (a variable, a command substitution) keeps the old folder, so a later relative write such as 'cd "$WT" && echo x > README.md' is judged against the wrong folder and allowed: the guard fails open.
